precondition.description: An ActivityStreams solicitation carries an immutable baseline and a bundle conforming to emsenn/schema/pure-mathematics-change-bundle; the customer accepts OML's exact offer and reciprocal-value term, and a capability admits only invoke-service plus provider-local write.

move.description: OML verifies unified-diff digest, exact changed paths, lack of application-shaped paths and dependencies, source-digested corpus grounding, and passed scope-audit and Lean-build evidence, then appends its own qualification or refusal, causal projections, receipt, and seller book.

postcondition.description: A completion identifies exactly what was mechanically verified and records that mathematical truth, corpus truth, evidence replay, and admission remain unverified or customer-owned. OML writes neither Obsmetrologia nor its history.

records: exact patch SHA-256 and path set
bilateral receipt and seller-side book entry
